title: Customer Service Representative
description: Handles inbound and outbound calls for international clients. Provides customer support, processes orders, and resolves customer concerns in a fast-paced environment.

title: Office Administrative Assistant
description: Provides administrative support, manages files, coordinates schedules, and assists in day-to-day office operations.

title: Registered Nurse
description: Provides direct patient care, administers medications, and coordinates with the medical team in a hospital setting.

title: Construction Laborer
description: Assists construction workers in residential and commercial building projects. Tasks include carrying materials, cleaning the site, and other general labor duties.
requirements: Prior construction experience preferred but not required

title: Software Developer
description: Develops and maintains web and mobile applications. Works with a team of engineers to design, build, and deploy software products.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related

title: Food Service Crew
description: Takes customer orders, prepares food, and ensures cleanliness and quality service standards at restaurant level.
requirements: Willing to work on weekends and holidays

title: Accountant
description: Handles financial reporting, tax preparation, and general ledger management for clients across various industries.

title: Public School Teacher (Elementary)
description: Teaches elementary school subjects in a public school setting. Prepares lesson plans, assesses students, and participates in school activities.
requirements: Bachelor of Elementary Education or equivalent
Willing to be assigned anywhere in NCR

title: Security Guard
description: Maintains the security and safety of assigned premises, monitors CCTV, and responds to security incidents.
requirements: Physically fit and with no criminal record

title: Tricycle Driver (Franchise Available)
description: Operates an e-tricycle under a barangay franchise. Daily income depends on ridership. DOLE livelihood assistance available.
